components.label: weight component
components.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

components.label: distance component
components.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

service_levels.quote: Only standard service is offered under this agreement.

surcharges.label: cold chain premium
surcharges.quote: Consignments booked as cold chain travel in refrigerated vehicles and carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components).

other_accessorials.quote: Freight per consignment is the sum of: ... a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight, and ... a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance.

credit_notes.quote: The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices. A credit note references the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects, and must cover the full corrected amount.

unmatched_lines.quote: The consignment note (c-note) number quoted on each invoice line is the Carrier's reference and must correspond to a Customer booking. Lines that cannot be matched to a booking are not payable until reconciled.

non_pricing.summary: Invoicing cadence (trips pooled, typically fortnightly) and payment due 21 days from invoice date — payment terms with no effect on price.
